title: 12. Goodbye, Little Worry Puff!
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: I'm Mongle, the little Worry Puff. At night, I creep out. When I munch on worries, I grow bigger and bigger. Tonight I'm excited. Tomorrow the Rainbow Class is going on a forest picnic, so there should be lots of worries to eat!

First came Hori's house. I slipped through a crack in the window. Hori tossed under the covers. What if I get lost in the forest? Good! I was about to munch, when Hori smiled. No, I'll be okay if I hold Teacher Sheep's hand! Pop! The worry vanished.

Next came Toto's house. Toto was wide awake. What if I arrive last? Everyone will look at me! Wonderful! I was about to munch, when Toto pulled up the covers. I'll go to bed early and get up early. It'll be okay! I shrank again.

Third came Bori's house. Bori felt afraid and shivered under the blanket. What if something scary is deep in the forest? Yes! A big worry! I opened wide to munch, when Bori peeked out. I'll be with my friends. It'll be okay. Oh! I grew even smaller.

Last came Kongi's house. Hungry, I had one last hope. Kongi murmured, What if I can't finish my lunch? What if there are bugs? At last, time to munch! But Kongi smiled. I'll share my lunch with my friends. It'll be okay! Then Kongi fell fast asleep.

I visited all four houses but didn't eat a single worry. My tummy was empty, and I had shrunk to the size of a bean. Why isn't anyone worrying? They all smile and say, It'll be okay. I was so hungry that I almost cried.

Just in case, I went back to Hori's window. Hori, Toto, Bori, and Kongi were all sleeping peacefully. Even in their sleep, they smiled and murmured, It'll be okay. At those words, I grew smaller and smaller.

Now I was so tiny that the night breeze made me wobble. Those few words, It'll be okay, had made me this small. Without worries to eat, I had no strength. But somehow, seeing my friends sleep peacefully didn't make me angry.
It was time for me to leave. Goodbye. I'll go now. I waved my tiny hand and drifted on the dawn breeze, far away among the stars. To fill my tummy, you would have to worry a lot.

The next morning, the Rainbow Class friends held hands and walked bravely into the forest. The Worry Puff was nowhere to be seen. When you feel worried, try saying, It'll be okay! Then I get hungry and float far away. Goodbye from Mongle!
